title: ‘Total repudiation’: The blue wave is about to hit AI
slides: Blue wave about to hit AI — but why repudiation?
Voters reject AI policies across party lines
Total repudiation targets Big Tech's unchecked power
New rules could reshape how your tools are built
Ask candidates where they stand on AI — today
thread_text:
1. Blue wave incoming

A blue wave is about to hit AI, but it's not what you think. Voters across party lines are rejecting AI policies, and Big Tech's unchecked power is the target.

2. Voters reject AI policies

Politicians who backed AI deregulation are losing votes. The repudiation is total, and it's reshaping how new rules get written.

3. Total repudiation targets Big Tech

Big Tech's unchecked power is the real issue. New rules could reshape how your tools are built, from algorithms to data access.

4. New rules, new tools

AI tools you use daily may change under new regulations. Companies will have to adapt, and users will notice the difference.

5. Ask candidates today

Before you vote, ask candidates where they stand on AI. Their answer will shape the tools you rely on tomorrow.
